hunks.baseline: The System notifications echoed in my ears like a ringing bell. But my gaze remained fixed solely on the spear.
hunks.sol: The System notifications echoed in my ears. But my gaze remained fixed on the spear.

hunks.baseline: Blue flames flickered over the spearhead. A thrilling shiver surged up my spine.
hunks.sol: Blue flames flickered over the spearhead. A thrilling shiver raced up my spine.

hunks.baseline: Today, I had taken one step toward a higher realm and conquered one of the peaks of the perilous mountain known as martial arts.
hunks.sol: Today, I had taken another step toward a higher realm and conquered one of the peaks in the perilous mountain known as martial arts.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, I became certain.
hunks.sol: At the same time, I knew one thing for certain.

hunks.baseline: No further thoughts or words were necessary. All that remained was the action that would turn years of waiting into reality.
hunks.sol: No more thoughts or words were needed. All that remained was to act and make those long years of waiting a reality.

hunks.baseline: But I wasn’t the only one waiting for this moving reunion.
hunks.sol: But I wasn’t the only one who had been waiting for this touching reunion.

hunks.baseline: The creature with its single eye wide open let out a roar filled with fury.
hunks.sol: Its lone eye bulging wide, the creature let out a furious roar.

hunks.baseline: No, it was closer to a thunderous boom than a roar.
hunks.sol: No, it was closer to a thunderclap than a roar.

hunks.baseline: The tremendous air pressure pouring from a maw large enough to swallow a car whole crushed down upon the ground. Compressed air burst around me, and it felt as if a thousand-geun boulder were pressing down on my shoulders.
hunks.sol: Tremendous pressure poured from a maw large enough to swallow a car whole and bore down on the ground. The compressed air burst around me, and it felt as though a thousand-geun boulder were crushing my shoulders.

hunks.baseline: One branch of a unique ability granted only to dragonkin.
hunks.sol: One branch of the innate power granted only to dragonkin.

hunks.baseline: Since a Named Monster was using it, even a capable Hunter would have had their eardrums burst and been forced to their knees.
hunks.sol: Coming from a Named Monster, it would have burst the eardrums of any ordinary Hunter and forced them to their knees.

hunks.baseline: I continued forward in silence, enduring the pressure crushing down on my shoulders.
hunks.sol: I silently pressed forward against the crushing pressure.

hunks.baseline: With every step, my ankles sank into the ground, and the pressure grew stronger. But it couldn’t stop my advance.
hunks.sol: With every step, my ankles sank into the ground and the pressure grew stronger, but it couldn’t stop me.

hunks.baseline: Even if it was a being that had surpassed the limits of an ordinary monster, I wasn’t afraid.
hunks.sol: The creature might have surpassed the limits of an ordinary monster, but I wasn’t afraid.

hunks.baseline: *Because the same was true of me.*
hunks.sol: *Because so have I.*

hunks.baseline: At least when it came to physical ability, I was already worthy of being called superhuman.
hunks.sol: At least in terms of physical ability, I could already be called superhuman.

hunks.baseline: Strength, speed, stamina. In everything that determined the outcome of battle, I stood one step ahead of a Peak master of equivalent level—or an A-Rank Hunter.
hunks.sol: Strength, speed, stamina—when it came to everything that determined the outcome of a battle, I stood one step ahead of a Peak master at my level, or an A-Rank Hunter.

hunks.baseline: I raised my head with a broad grin.
hunks.sol: I raised my head with a grin.

hunks.baseline: Above the gigantic torso that rose like a skyscraper, the red eye of the creature spewing Air Breath wavered when it saw my smile.
hunks.sol: Atop its skyscraper-sized torso, the red eye of the creature blasting out Air Breath wavered when it saw my smile.

hunks.baseline: “What was that just now? Your fan on high?”
hunks.sol: “What was that? A fan set to high?”

hunks.baseline: “Turn the fan off. You’re blowing yellow dust everywhere, you bastard!”
hunks.sol: “Turn it off! You’re blowing yellow dust everywhere, you bastard!”

hunks.baseline: At the same time as I shouted, I swung the spear shaft toward the sky with all my strength.
hunks.sol: As I shouted, I swung the spear toward the sky with all my strength.

hunks.baseline: The instant the blue flame of qi carved a semicircle through the air, burning it, the pressure crushing down on my entire body vanished. My body became as light as a feather.
hunks.sol: The blue flame of qi carved a semicircle through the air, burning through it. In that instant, the pressure crushing my body vanished, and I became as light as a feather.

hunks.baseline: The confused creature twisted its head and unleashed another Air Breath, but it couldn’t keep up with my speed.
hunks.sol: Startled, the creature twisted its head and unleashed another Air Breath, but it couldn’t keep up with my speed.

hunks.baseline: Carrying nothing but light leather armor and a single spear, I crossed the battlefield like lightning and reached the creature’s front before I knew it.
hunks.sol: Clad in nothing but light leather armor and carrying a single spear, I streaked across the battlefield like lightning. In the blink of an eye, I was right in front of it.

hunks.baseline: The startled creature spread its folded wings wide. But by then, I had already leaped with all my strength.
hunks.sol: The startled creature spread its folded wings wide, but by then, I had already leaped.

hunks.baseline: With a powerful tremor, I soared into the air. Through my hair streaming in the wind, I saw the creature’s knee beneath its flashing black scales.
hunks.sol: The ground shook as I soared into the air. Through my hair whipping in the wind, I saw its knee beneath the gleaming black scales.

hunks.baseline: The very area people called the cruciate ligament.
hunks.sol: The exact spot known as the cruciate ligament.

hunks.baseline: “You’re exempt from military service, you bastard!”
hunks.sol: “Congratulations! You’re exempt from military service, you bastard!”

hunks.baseline: Thrust! Shrrrk!
hunks.sol: Thud! Shrrrk!

hunks.baseline: The Wyvern’s hide and scales, said to withstand ordinary magic and weapons alike, split open in an instant.
hunks.sol: The Wyvern’s hide and scales, said to repel ordinary magic and weapons alike, split open in an instant.

hunks.baseline: A sharp, satisfying jolt traveled through my fingertips, like the feeling of harpooning a fish.
hunks.sol: A sharp, satisfying jolt traveled through my fingertips, like harpooning a fish.

hunks.baseline: Once the spearhead had opened a gap, the rest was easy. As if hammering in a nail, I used my fist to drive the two-meter spear into the creature’s knee.
hunks.sol: Once the spearhead opened a gap, the rest was easy. Like hammering in a nail, I slammed my fist against the butt of the two-meter spear and drove it deep into the creature’s knee.

hunks.baseline: Dark blood erupted like a fountain. The creature, which had just spread its wings and tried to take flight, dropped to its knees with a scream.
hunks.sol: Dark blood erupted like a fountain. Just as the creature spread its wings to take flight, it dropped to one knee with a scream.

hunks.baseline: But I didn’t stop there. I stepped on the end of the spear shaft lodged in its knee and used its springiness to launch myself upward.
hunks.sol: But I didn’t stop there. I stepped onto the end of the spear lodged in its knee and used its spring to launch myself upward.

hunks.baseline: As I shot several more meters into the air, a dagger had appeared in my hand.
hunks.sol: As I shot several more meters into the air, a dagger appeared in my hand.

hunks.baseline: My real-world Inventory held countless weapons, not just the ones in the Murim.
hunks.sol: I had countless weapons stored in my Inventory, both in Murim and in the real world.

hunks.baseline: I had spent a fortune buying them before, but if it meant killing this creature, I wouldn’t regret spending ten times that amount.
hunks.sol: They had cost me a fortune, but if it meant killing this creature, I wouldn’t mind spending ten times as much.

hunks.baseline: Thrust!
hunks.sol: Thud!

hunks.baseline: I suddenly remembered practicing the Wall Lizard Technique in the Murim. The cliff I had climbed back then had been even higher, and there had been hardly anything suitable to use as a foothold.
hunks.sol: I suddenly remembered training in the Wall Lizard Technique back in Murim. The cliff I had scaled then was even higher, and there had hardly been anything to use as a foothold.

hunks.baseline: *Whenever I thought I’d climbed far enough, some lunatic would drop rocks on me.*
hunks.sol: *And whenever I thought I’d made some progress, a certain lunatic would start dropping rocks on me.*

hunks.baseline: Compared to that, this was hardly difficult.
hunks.sol: Compared to that, this was nothing.

hunks.baseline: I repeatedly drove the dagger into the creature’s enormous body, soaring upward, higher and higher.
hunks.sol: I drove dagger after dagger into the creature’s enormous body and climbed higher and higher.

hunks.baseline: Thrust, thrust! Thrust-thrust-thrust!
hunks.sol: Thud, thud! Thud-thud-thud!

hunks.baseline: Before Spear Energy, neither the hide harder than iron armor nor the scales that deflected low-level magic were of any use.
hunks.sol: Against Spear Energy, neither hide harder than plate armor nor scales capable of deflecting low-level magic were of any use.

hunks.baseline: It was easy to imagine a palm-sized something crawling up your body and driving nails into you over and over.
hunks.sol: Imagine something the size of your palm crawling up your body and hammering nails into you over and over.

hunks.baseline: That was exactly what was happening to the creature now.
hunks.sol: That was exactly what the creature was going through.

hunks.baseline: Unable to endure the pain assailing it without end, the creature writhed with a roar. It was trying to shake me off, but it was too late.
hunks.sol: Unable to endure the relentless pain, it writhed and roared. It was trying to shake me off, but it was one step too late.

hunks.baseline: By then, I was already enjoying the sensation of floating in midair.
hunks.sol: By then, I was already savoring the sensation of floating through the air.

hunks.baseline: The next moment, a solid spear shaft appeared in my empty hand.
hunks.sol: The next instant, a solid spear shaft filled my empty hand.

hunks.baseline: The Scorching Yang Qi that had surpassed one jiazi when I opened my Conception and Governor Vessels surged toward the spearhead like an ebb tide.
hunks.sol: The Scorching Yang Qi that had surpassed one jiazi when I opened my Conception and Governor Vessels surged toward the spearhead like an ebbing tide.

hunks.baseline: Blue flames wrapped tightly around the spearhead.
hunks.sol: Blue flames enveloped the spearhead without leaving the slightest gap.

hunks.baseline: “Where do you think you’re running?”
hunks.sol: “Where do you think you’re going?”

hunks.baseline: With that quiet murmur, I became one with the spear and plunged rapidly downward. My target was the creature’s wing, which served as both its foreleg and its arm.
hunks.sol: With that quiet murmur, I became one with the spear and plunged downward. My target was its wing, which served as both foreleg and arm.

hunks.baseline: Blinded by pain for a moment, the creature had no way to stop the meteor.
hunks.sol: Blinded by pain, the creature had no way to stop the meteor.

hunks.baseline: Scorching Yang Qi, burning like a small sun, sliced through hide and scales and scorched the flesh beneath. The wing, with a vertical span of more than ten meters, split in two along the spearhead.
hunks.sol: Scorching Yang Qi blazed like a miniature sun, slicing through hide and scales and burning the flesh beneath. The wing, more than ten meters from top to bottom, split in two along the path of the spearhead.

hunks.baseline: It was probably the worst pain the creature had ever experienced. The red eye of the predator that had lived its entire life as a hunter flew wide open.
hunks.sol: It was probably the worst pain the creature had ever experienced. The red eye of a beast that had spent its entire life as a predator flew wide.

hunks.baseline: I landed lightly on the ground and stared at it with a cold, steady gaze.
hunks.sol: I landed lightly on the ground and regarded it with a cold, steady gaze.

hunks.baseline: Within the thick cloud of dust rising around us, the creature’s fifty-meter bulk writhed.
hunks.sol: Its fifty-meter bulk writhed within the billowing cloud of dust.

hunks.baseline: A single flap of its wings had shattered entire bodies, and heads seized in its claws had vanished without a trace. Not even the corpses of those swallowed by its enormous maw could be found.
hunks.sol: A single flap of its wings had shattered entire bodies. Heads clutched in its claws had vanished without a trace. Those swallowed by its enormous maw hadn’t even left corpses behind.

hunks.baseline: That was when I first learned that the human body held so much blood and so many organs.
hunks.sol: That was when I first learned how much blood and how many organs the human body contained.

hunks.baseline: That a person could die so brutally.
hunks.sol: How brutally a person could die.

hunks.baseline: “You bastard. I wouldn’t feel satisfied even if I chewed you to death.”
hunks.sol: “You bastard. I wouldn’t be satisfied even if I chewed you to death.”

hunks.baseline: This creature would die here today, by my hand. And it had to die horribly—exactly as I had imagined countless times before.
hunks.sol: It would die here today, by my hand. And it would die horribly—exactly as I had imagined countless times before.

hunks.baseline: The wind rising along the spearhead as I swung it drove away the dust.
hunks.sol: The wind stirred by my swinging spear swept away the dust.

hunks.baseline: The creature, covered in blood and dirt, glared at me while breathing heavily.
hunks.sol: Covered in blood and dirt, the creature glared at me as it panted heavily.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of blades were embedded throughout its body, and blood poured from its open wounds like waterfalls.
hunks.sol: Dozens of blades protruded from its body, and blood poured from its gaping wounds like waterfalls.

hunks.baseline: Only one of the wings that symbolized the Wyvern remained.
hunks.sol: Of the wings that symbolized the Wyvern, only one remained.

hunks.baseline: It was still enormous and imposing, but there was no longer any trace of its dignity as a dragonkin offshoot or a Named Monster.
hunks.sol: It was still enormous and imposing, but there was no longer any trace of the dignity befitting a dragonkin offshoot and a Named Monster.

hunks.baseline: Its eye, full of resentment and killing intent, glared at me.
hunks.sol: Its eye, brimming with resentment and killing intent, glared at me.

hunks.baseline: The emotions conveyed by that gaze were unlike anything I had ever known from a monster.
hunks.sol: The emotions in that gaze were unlike anything I had ever seen from a monster.

hunks.baseline: “Keep that eye nice and gentle. Otherwise, I’ll pluck it out first.”
hunks.sol: “Watch how you look at me, or I’ll pluck that eye out first.”

hunks.baseline: I tossed out the words and began walking toward it.
hunks.sol: I tossed out the warning and took a step toward it.

hunks.baseline: It was a single word that made me doubt my own ears.
hunks.sol: A single word made me doubt my own ears.

hunks.baseline: My feet froze in place. The corners of my eyes trembled involuntarily.
hunks.sol: My feet froze. The corner of my eye twitched involuntarily.

hunks.baseline: But I hadn’t misheard it. The creature’s maw shifted, and a clearer pronunciation emerged.
hunks.sol: But I hadn’t misheard it. The creature’s maw moved, and the next words emerged more clearly.

hunks.baseline: That very “monster” was speaking.
hunks.sol: That very *monster*.

hunks.baseline: A groan-like voice leaked through my parted lips.
hunks.sol: A groan slipped through my parted lips.

hunks.baseline: “This can’t be happening…”
hunks.sol: “This is impossible…”

hunks.baseline: The instant it finished speaking, the creature’s red eye turned completely bloodred.
hunks.sol: The instant it finished speaking, its red eye turned completely bloodred.

hunks.baseline: The One-Eyed Carus.
hunks.sol: Carus the One-Eyed.

hunks.baseline: Before earning that name, he had endured countless crises. He had fought not only monsters, but humans as well.
hunks.sol: Before earning that name, he had survived countless crises. He had fought not only monsters, but humans as well.

hunks.baseline: He had repeated battles hundreds of times—winning meant obtaining prey, while losing meant becoming prey.
hunks.sol: He had fought hundreds of battles where victory meant claiming prey and defeat meant becoming prey.

hunks.baseline: At least, until a human took one of his eyes.
hunks.sol: Not until one human took his eye.

hunks.baseline: *How dare he? How dare a human less worthy than a bug do this to me!*
hunks.sol: *How dare he? How dare a human lower than a bug do this to me!*

hunks.baseline: Carus was furious. At the same time, he made a vow.
hunks.sol: Carus was furious, and he made a vow.

hunks.baseline: He would kill the human who had taken his eye. Even if he couldn’t find that human, he would kill other humans again and again.
hunks.sol: He would kill the human who had taken his eye. Even if he never found him, he would kill other humans again and again.

hunks.baseline: One day, after repeating battle and slaughter countless times, he suddenly came to his senses and realized that he had become the owner of an enormous body and tremendous strength.
hunks.sol: Then one day, after endless battle and slaughter, he realized that he had grown to an enormous size and gained tremendous strength.

hunks.baseline: *Why? Did I grow stronger by fighting humans?*
hunks.sol: *Why? Did fighting humans make me stronger?*

hunks.baseline: Before long, Carus understood. The reason he had grown stronger wasn’t because of his battles with humans, but because he had eaten other monsters.
hunks.sol: Before long, Carus understood. It wasn’t his battles with humans that had made him stronger, but devouring other monsters.

hunks.baseline: And every time he did, something inside his body grew stronger.
hunks.sol: Each time he did, something inside his body grew more powerful.

hunks.baseline: *What did the humans call this? Oh, right.*
hunks.sol: *What did the humans call it again? Ah, right.*

hunks.baseline: After learning the reason for his growing strength, Carus began hunting Magic Gems.
hunks.sol: Once he understood the source of his strength, Carus began hunting Magic Gems.

hunks.baseline: He devoured other monsters and, rather than human flesh, studied the magic equipment the humans carried.
hunks.sol: He devoured other monsters, and instead of feasting on human flesh, he studied the magic equipment they carried.

hunks.baseline: *So this is how those human bastards use Magic Gems.*
hunks.sol: *So this is how those humans use Magic Gems.*

hunks.baseline: As a Wyvern—a lesser branch of the dragonkin—Carus had possessed remarkable Intelligence to begin with. At last, he was able to set foot in a new realm.
hunks.sol: As a Wyvern, a lesser branch of the dragonkin, Carus had possessed remarkable Intelligence to begin with. At last, he set foot in an entirely new realm.

hunks.baseline: Carus established a new nest in a nameless wasteland. He killed everything that might become an obstacle and delved deeply into magic.
hunks.sol: Carus built a new nest in a nameless wasteland. He killed everything that might get in his way and immersed himself in the study of magic.

hunks.baseline: That was when he noticed the humans invading his territory.
hunks.sol: Then he noticed the humans invading his territory.

hunks.baseline: *Until he smelled that bastard.*
hunks.sol: Until he caught *that bastard’s* scent.

hunks.baseline: *My eye! The human who took my eye!*
hunks.sol: *My eye! It’s the human who took my eye!*

hunks.baseline: But that bastard was strong. Even Carus, who had absorbed hundreds of Magic Gems, was pushed back helplessly.
hunks.sol: But the bastard was strong. Even Carus, who had absorbed hundreds of Magic Gems, was completely overwhelmed.

hunks.baseline: Yet he still had one last card to play.
hunks.sol: Yet he still had one card left to play.

hunks.baseline: —Heal.
hunks.sol: —Heal!

hunks.baseline: His wounds closed, and the bleeding stopped. He couldn’t completely restore his torn wing, but this was enough.
hunks.sol: His wounds closed, and the bleeding stopped. He couldn’t fully restore his severed wing, but this was enough.

hunks.baseline: Carus had already experienced that speed firsthand, so he cast the spell without hesitation.
hunks.sol: Having already experienced Jin Taekyung’s speed firsthand, Carus cast another spell without hesitation.

hunks.baseline: Some faint trace of dragon blood flowed through Carus’s veins.
hunks.sol: A faint trace of dragon blood flowed through Carus’s veins.

hunks.baseline: Five Slow spells overlapped, surrounding Jin Taekyung’s body.
hunks.sol: Five Slow spells stacked atop one another and enveloped Jin Taekyung’s body.

hunks.baseline: Carus burst into laughter as he watched Jin Taekyung move as slowly as possible.
hunks.sol: Carus threw back his head and laughed as Jin Taekyung slowed to a crawl.

hunks.baseline: His enormous eye filled with the sight of a spearhead holding blue flames.
hunks.sol: A spearhead wreathed in blue flames filled his enormous eye.
